title: The one-period Kyle model has one equilibrium
abstract: arXiv:2607.23585v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Let $V$ and $U$ be independent standard normal random variables. For each Borel-measurable function $\phi\colon\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$, let $P_\phi\colon\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ be a Borel version of the inverse regression $y\mapsto\mathbb{E}[V\mid\phi(V)+U=y]$. We prove that $\phi(v)\in\operatorname*{arg\,max}_{x\in\mathbb{R}} \mathbb{E}[(v-P_\phi(x+U))x]$ for every $v\in\mathbb{R}$ if and only if $\phi=\operatorname{id}_{\mathbb{R}}$.   The rigidity result implies that the one-period Gaussian Kyle (1985) insider-trading model has a unique Borel-measurable equilibrium strategy, namely Kyle's affine strategy. Building on preliminary results of McLennan, Monteiro, and Tourky (2017), the proof establishes that, at equilibrium, the total expected loss of noise traders attains a sharp universal upper bound and that any strategy attaining this bound must be affine almost everywhere.

translated_title: 单周期Kyle模型存在唯一均衡
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.23585v4 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：设$V$和$U$为独立的标准正态随机变量。对于每个Borel可测函数$\phi\colon\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$，令$P_\phi\colon\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$为逆回归$y\mapsto\mathbb{E}[V\mid\phi(V)+U=y]$的Borel版本。我们证明，对于每个$v\in\mathbb{R}$，$\phi(v)\in\operatorname*{arg\,max}_{x\in\mathbb{R}} \mathbb{E}[(v-P_\phi(x+U))x]$当且仅当$\phi=\operatorname{id}_{\mathbb{R}}$。这一刚性结果意味着单周期高斯Kyle（1985）内幕交易模型具有唯一的Borel可测均衡策略，即Kyle的仿射策略。基于McLennan、Monteiro和Tourky（2017）的初步结果，证明确立了在均衡状态下，噪声交易者的总期望损失达到一个尖锐的通用上界，且任何达到该上界的策略必须几乎处处为仿射形式。
tldr: 该论文证明了单周期高斯Kyle内幕交易模型存在唯一均衡策略，即仿射策略，并通过噪声交易者损失的上界刚性结果强化了这一结论。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the one-period Gaussian Kyle insider-trading model has a unique equilibrium strategy, namely the affine strategy, strengthened by a rigidity result on the sharp upper bound of noise traders' expected loss.
